set system host-name CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit 10 vlan-id 10.explanation: Configure the VLAN ID of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID to identify different virtual local area networks.

unit 10 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set protocols bgp group eBGP.explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

type external.explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, e.g. external.

peer-as 100.explanation: Configure the BGP group's equivalent AS.

parameters.name: peer-as
parameters.explanation: Reciprocal AS, used to mark the autonomous system of BGP neighbours.

neighbor 10.1.1.1 family inet unicast.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings including group, neighbor, and address family

parameters.name: neighbor IP address
parameters.explanation: IP address of the BGP neighbor

export connected-routes.explanation: Configure BGP groups to export connected paths.

parameters.name: export-policy
parameters.explanation: Exportes the policy name to specify the path you want to export.

set policy-options policy-statement conn.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

term 1 from protocol direct.explanation: Configures the matching condition for a policy statement as a direct route.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.explanation: Matches the type of protocol, such as direct.

term 1 then accept.explanation: Configure the operation of the policy statement to be accepted.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.
